name: Kanaden Corporation
summary: Kanaden Corporation operates as an electronics solutions company in Japan and internationally. It provides factory automation systems, including sequencers, inverters, AC servos, robots, and other control and drive systems; wireless sensors, total production control systems, and direct current power supplies; electrical discharge and laser processing machines; power semiconductors and network ICs and memory; connectors and connectors for wired LAN; and wireless modules and solutions.
